## What is CSS?

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to customize the appearance of a website. It allows us to change colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts.

CSS is useful for creating a professional and consistent design across different website pages.

## What is SCSS?

SCSS is an extension of CSS that offers additional features, such as variables and nested styling rules.

These features make it easier to organize and manage website designs.

## Using CSS/SCSS in Quarto

Quarto allows users to customize their websites beyond the default themes.

CSS and SCSS can be used to:

- Customize website colors and fonts
- Improve spacing and page layouts
- Style headings and navigation menus
- Maintain a consistent design

## CSS Example

This example changes the color and size of headings.

```css
h1 {
  color: #234e70;
  font-size: 32px;
}
```

## SCSS Example

SCSS allows us to create reusable variables.

```scss
$primary-color: #234e70;

h1 {
  color: $primary-color;
}
```
